name: Wanda Denvers
source: She is the principal of Middleton High School. She is the mother of [url=/c133330]Faye[/url] and her twin brother and sister, [url=/c133331]Gene[/url] and [url=/c133334]Lois[/url]. Since the divorce from her husband, she has been lonely.
